scheme_name: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
description:
The Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units under the Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana was launched in the state of Jharkhand on 1st April 2021. 

This initiative aims to enhance the livelihood of economically weaker sections of society by promoting poultry farming. 

The scheme is specifically designed to provide financial assistance to families living below the poverty line. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to empower marginalized communities by providing them with sustainable income sources through backyard poultry farming. 

The government aims to establish at least 10,000 backyard poultry units in the state within the first year of implementation. 

Each unit is expected to consist of 20 to 25 hens. 

The scheme provides a subsidy of 50 percent of the total cost of establishing a backyard poultry unit. 

The maximum financial assistance provided under this scheme is ₹10,000 per unit. 

This amount is intended to cover the cost of purchasing birds, feed, and necessary equipment. 

The scheme targets families with an annual income of less than ₹1 lakh. 

Eligibility is restricted to individuals who are residents of Jharkhand. 

Beneficiaries must also demonstrate a willingness to engage in poultry farming. 

The application process involves several steps. 

Interested applicants must first visit the official website of the Jharkhand Animal Husbandry Department. 

They need to download the application form available on the website. 

The completed application form must be submitted to the nearest Animal Husbandry office. 

Applicants are required to attach specific documents with their application. 

These documents include proof of residence such as an Aadhar card or voter ID. 

They must also provide an income certificate issued by the local revenue department. 

Additionally, a self-declaration stating their willingness to undertake poultry farming is required. 

Once the application is submitted, the concerned authorities will conduct a verification process. 

This verification process typically takes about 15 days. 

Upon successful verification, the financial assistance will be disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account. 

The disbursement is expected to occur within 30 days of application approval. 

The scheme also includes training programs for beneficiaries. 

These training programs are conducted by the Animal Husbandry Department. 

The training covers various aspects of poultry farming including feeding, health care, and management practices. 

The government aims to conduct at least 100 training sessions in the first year. 

Each training session can accommodate up to 30 participants. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Fisheries, Government of Jharkhand. 

For any queries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the department at their official helpline number, which is +91-651-240-0000. 

The department also has an official email address for inquiries: ahd.jharkhand@gmail.com. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to uplift the socio-economic status of the poorest families in Jharkhand. 

The Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana was launched on 1st January 2020. 

This overarching scheme aims to provide various welfare benefits to the poorest of the poor in the state. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹100 crores for the implementation of this scheme. 

The backyard poultry scheme is one of the key components of this larger initiative. 

The government has also partnered with various NGOs to facilitate the implementation of the scheme. 

These partnerships aim to ensure effective outreach and support for beneficiaries. 

The scheme is expected to create employment opportunities for women in rural areas. 

Women are often the primary caretakers of poultry in these households. 

The government anticipates that this will lead to improved nutrition and income for families. 

The scheme also aims to promote local breeds of poultry that are better adapted to the local environment. 

This is expected to enhance the sustainability of poultry farming in the region. 

The government encourages beneficiaries to adopt organic farming practices. 

This includes using natural feed and avoiding chemical additives. 

The scheme is expected to contribute to the overall development of rural economies in Jharkhand. 

It aligns with the national goal of promoting self-reliance and entrepreneurship among rural populations. 

The government will monitor the progress of the scheme through regular assessments. 

These assessments will help in understanding the impact of the scheme on beneficiaries' livelihoods. 

The scheme also aims to create awareness about the importance of poultry farming in rural development. 

The government plans to publish success stories of beneficiaries to inspire others. 

The scheme is expected to be reviewed annually to assess its effectiveness and make necessary adjustments. 

The government aims to increase the number of backyard poultry units to 50,000 by the end of the third year. 

This ambitious target reflects the government's commitment to improving the living standards of the poorest families. 

The scheme is a significant step towards achieving food security and economic stability in Jharkhand. 

The government emphasizes the importance of community participation in the success of the scheme. 

Local self-help groups are encouraged to play a role in training and supporting beneficiaries. 

The scheme is expected to have a multiplier effect on the local economy. 

By increasing poultry production, it will also boost local markets and create demand for related services. 

The government is optimistic about the long-term benefits of this initiative for rural households. 

This scheme is a clear example of targeted welfare measures aimed at poverty alleviation. 

It reflects the government's approach to empower individuals through skill development and financial support. 

Overall, the Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana is a comprehensive initiative aimed at transforming the livelihoods of the poorest families in Jharkhand.
